children: Cactus Acquisition Corp. 1 Ltd reported results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, posting a net loss of $0.29M and a basic and diluted loss per non‑redeemable share of $(0.09). The company said declining interest income and constrained operating cash outside its trust account weighed on pre‑combination activity as it works toward a planned business combination.
Net income: Net loss of $0.29M for the six months ended Jun 30, 2026, versus a net loss of $0.16M for the six months ended Jun 30, 2025.
Diluted EPS: Basic and diluted loss per non‑redeemable share $(0.09) for six months ended Jun 30, 2026, versus $(0.12) in the year‑ago period.
Financial drivers: Interest income fell to $11K for the six months (from $188K year‑ago), which increased the net loss despite lower operating expenses.
Business combination progress: Executing a definitive business combination agreement with Tembo; an F‑4 registration statement was filed confidentially and is being revised following SEC comments.

Timing and listing: The company is targeting closing the combination before its agreement deadline on Nov. 2, 2026. Cactus Acquisition was delisted from Nasdaq and currently trades on the OTC; the combined company intends to reapply for Nasdaq uplisting after the transaction.

Operational constraints: Limited operating cash outside the trust account has constrained pre‑combination operations and increased reliance on third‑party funding for due diligence and transaction completion.
